CustomField.description: User-friendly expression of time in status
CustomField.formula: TEXT(MFLOOR(TotalHoursInStatus__c / 60 / 60 / 24)) & ' Days, ' & TEXT(MFLOOR(MOD((TotalHoursInStatus__c / 60 / 60), 24))) & ' Hours, ' & TEXT(MFLOOR(MOD((TotalHoursInStatus__c / 60) ,60))) & ' Minutes, ' & TEXT(MFLOOR(MOD(TotalHoursInStatus__c, 60))) & ' Seconds'
CustomField.label: Time In Status
